exact_result: For every finite balanced rational graph whose connected components are trees and whose local nonnegative relation cones are exactly their positive rational weight rays, times any complete rational affine factor with direct product lattice, every positive-growth continuous real-PA PC reference and every bounded real-PA obstacle on finite rational spatial domains has an actual real-PAPC envelope with bounded reference difference and full recursive Monge-Ampere measure supported on contact. Arbitrary nonseparable functions, bounded-edge lengths, valences, rational weights and nonsaturated ray-generated local lattices are included. Unverified partial research theorem.
concrete_gaps: The original P05.2 classification of arbitrary balanced rational polyhedral pairs remains open.
The graph-cylinder theorem with graph cycles remains unproved; tree lattice gluing and branch independence do not extend without extra period arguments.
No finite parametric scalar graph-LP or its Legendre reconstruction is proved for cyclic graphs.
No literal integral-slope inference, analytic realization, independent review or formal verification is claimed.
